instruction: I accidentally moved the party night poster to Trash. Please restore it to the Desktop folder.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: [ -f /home/user/Desktop/poster_party_night.webp ] && echo 'File exists.' || echo 'File does not exist.'

metadata.explanation: Task requires recovering a trashed file back to Desktop. Same pattern as original, with paraphrased instruction. Evaluator checks file presence on Desktop using shell command.

exact_match metric appropriately compares command output with expected value
